section_summary.extract_value: This section details the results of an experiment involving 11 participants. It describes the exclusion of two outliers, normality checks, and a repeated measures ANOVA showing significant differences in reaction times across three trial types (frequent target, rare target, no target). Further analyses focused on the oddball effect, and ERP components (N2 and P3b) were examined, including a non-significant correlation between RT and N2 oddball effects.
section_summary.evidence_source: 2.1. Results Two participants were outliers with average RTs larger than 2.5 standard deviation of the mean in at least one trial type, and so they were excluded from the analyses. ... A repeated measure ANOVA on the 11 participants with complete datasets showed that mean RT differed between the three types of trials [F(2,20) = 119.69, p < .001]. ... The ERPs elicited by the rare targets included a frontocentral N2 followed by a parietal P3b (Fig. 3). ... There was a positive but non-significant correlation between the RT and N2 oddball effects (r = .45, p = .16).
